messages:
maya: Quick sync: need to pick the default internal surface for inference routing. I propose gRPC/protos internally + a thin JSON gateway at the edge.
jc: gRPC internal makes sense. Concern: partners and console expect JSON. How to avoid double-maintenance?
taylor: If we do JSON transcoding at gateway, ensure telemetry and quota attributes survive. Envoy transcoding can drop headers.
nina: Proto-first is fine but watch streaming and patch semantics. If streaming is required, maybe a separate HTTP endpoint.
maya: Streaming is uncommon for control plane; keep unary RPCs and handle job-status separately.
jc: Minimal gateway that proxies JSON->gRPC (no biz logic) keeps routing centralized. Need stable gateway contract & versioning.
taylor: Gateway must emit route keys: service, method, model_variant, route_policy for console dashboards. Quota keys must match control plane composite.
sam: For rollouts: console needs canary controls (eg 5% v2) and strong rollback triggers (error rate, p95).
nina: Proto sketch: repo/inference/proto/*.proto with google.api.http annotations. Add strict validation in gateway to reject unknown fields. Example: service Routing { rpc Route(Request) returns (Resp) { option (google.api.http) = { post: "/v1/route" body: "*" }; } }
maya: Gateway will add x-rdwd-route and x-rdwd-tenant headers -> map to gRPC metadata. Also inject traceparent.
jc: Keep header names short. Fallback: if header missing, token introspection service recomputes attributes; surface metric when header population fails.
taylor: Metrics to add: route_latency_ms, route_error_count, quota_check_latency, quota_rejected_local, quota_rejected_auth. Dashboards should break down by tenant/model.
sam: Rollout plan: 1) schema freeze, 2) gateway with strict validation in staging, 3) enable headers + tracing, 4) integration tests for quotas, 5) canary 5% for 24h.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: maya pushed proto-gateway branch to staging at 4951112333 :rocket: 
nina: Lint rule: every proto must include google.api.http and an example in docs.
maya: Action items: jc -> gateway design doc (headers mapping) by Wed EOD; nina -> proto linter; taylor -> dashboard mocks; sam -> rollout thresholds + console button mock. I'll open a follow-up thread for long-polling.
jc: +1, will post doc link here when ready.
